But Rongtai wanted to secretly transport the body away. When the local people discovered it, they immediately exploded. What's even more outrageous is that the security guards at the factory opened fire on the gathered crowd, killing another person. The crowd rushed into the factory, smashed, looted and burned. Equipment, vehicles and office areas were all destroyed, and many Chinese employees were injured. Two lives lost: a forklift driver and a civilian shot in the conflict. title: 菲律宾防长指挥军队抓捕中国工人始末！ 八个问题，把特奥多罗的底裤扒干净了。8月15日晚，中国驻菲律宾使馆发言人季凌鹏对菲防长特奥多罗的声明作出回应。八个问题，句句见血。 🟡 第一，防长抓人，谁给你的权力？ 特奥多罗指挥军队冲到三佳钢厂抓捕手无寸铁的中国工人。他是防长还是警察局长？执法是警察的事，军队是打仗的。防长亲自带队抓工人——这不是越权，是滥用职权。 🟡 第二，选择性执法，为什么只抓中国人？ 如果工厂违反环保法律，为什么不抓老板和负责人，只抓工人？为什么只抓中国工人，菲律宾工人当场释放？选择性执法的证据，摆在桌面上。 🟡 第三，摆拍构陷，教科书级的栽赃。 工人平日只穿正常劳动服装。突袭当天，执法人员让3名中国工人穿上防护服摆拍，大肆炒作“中国工人穿防护服、菲律宾工人不穿”。这不是执法，是演戏。 🟡 第四，5

title_en: The Philippine Defense Secretary commanded the army to arrest Chinese workers! Eight questions, Teodoro's underwear was stripped clean. On the evening of August 15, Ji Lingpeng, spokesperson of the Chinese Embassy in the Philippines, responded to Philippine Defense Secretary Teodoro’s statement. Eight questions, every sentence is bloody. 🟡 First, who gave you the power to arrest people, as the defense minister did? Teodoro commanded the army to rush to the Sanjia Steel Factory to arrest unarmed Chinese workers. Is he the defense minister or the police chief? Law enforcement is the responsibility of the police, while the military is responsible for fighting. The Minister of Defense personally led a team to arrest the workers - this was not an act of overstepping his authority, but an abuse of power. 🟡Second, selective law enforcement, why only arrest Chinese people? If a factory violates environmental protection laws, why not arrest the boss and the person in charge, but only the workers? Why were only the Chinese workers arrested and the Filipino workers released on the spot? The evidence of selective enforcement is on the table. 🟡Third, it’s a frame-up, a textbook level frame-up. Workers only wear normal work clothes on weekdays. On the day of the raid, law enforcement officers asked three Chinese workers to put on protective clothing and pose for photos, hyping up the hype that "Chinese workers wear protective clothing but Filipino workers do not." This is not law enforcement, this is acting. 🟡 Fourth, 5
